captured_token_budget.scope: All unique cumulative coordinator and descendant input, cached input and output tokens, including failed work and rework. Reasoning is an output subset. No new paid calibration or posthoc model judge.
captured_token_budget.unknown_tail_policy: No further launch after interruption, missing accounting, a live/offline discrepancy, or a claimed run without complete retained evidence.
captured_token_budget.caveat: Counters are discrete. In-flight or missing tails remain unknown; the reserve is not a hard provider billing guarantee. Stopped or unstarted runs are incomplete evidence, not savings.

execution_policy.paired_order: Noisy qs pair first, then short Go pair; arm order fixed by the preregistered seed before observing outcomes.
identical_in_both_arms: Native short source reads and scoped search
Canonical saved worker briefs and hash verification
Managed task prepare and finish bookkeeping
Fresh Sol/high QE, developer, reviewer and Git workers
Role permissions, meaningful red test, independent review, declared checks and commit hook
execution_policy.normal_arm: Ordinary declared-check output; retrieve necessary diagnostics after native truncation.
execution_policy.compact_arm: Compact output for noisy Tape checks with necessary retained-log expansion; ordinary short Go output remains appropriate.
execution_policy.repository_retrieval_compaction: Disabled in both arms to isolate check observations.
execution_policy.bookkeeping_authority: Local write bounds and current check evidence only; no semantic TDD, independent review, approval or completion certification.

limitations: Four planned identities on two selected tasks do not establish quality preservation or general token savings.
Offline output-byte differences are not model-token measurements.
Source paths, credentials, provider payloads and private oracle contents are excluded from this public export. Private frozen evidence retains the full content bindings.
